extintor.title: Guide - Fire Extinguisher Inspection
extintor.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Extinguishers"**
2. Tap on the desired extinguisher
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in:
   - **Inspection Date** (required)
   - **Service Type:** Inspection, Maintenance N2, Maintenance N3 or Replacement
   - **Approved in Inspection?:** Yes or No
   - **General Observations** (optional)
5. If rejected, attach photo (required)
6. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
extintor.howToRegisterEquipmentContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Extinguishers"**
2. Tap the **"+"** button in the bottom right corner
3. Fill in the equipment data
4. Tap **"Save"**
extintor.faqPhotoAnswer: Whenever the extinguisher is rejected in the inspection (required).

mangueira.title: Guide - Hoses
mangueira.howToRegisterContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Hoses"**
2. Tap the **"+"** button
3. Fill in: ID, diameter, type, length, year of manufacture
4. Tap **"Save"**
mangueira.faqFrequencyAnswer: Annual hydrostatic test required according to NBR 12779.

camara_espuma.title: Guide - Foam Chambers
camara_espuma.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Foam Chambers"**
2. Tap on the desired chamber
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Choose type: **Semiannual Visual** or **Annual Functional**
6. Complete the checklist
7. If there is non-conformity or functional test, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
camara_espuma.faqFrequencyAnswer: Semiannual visual (6 months) and annual functional required.

canhao_monitor.title: Guide - Monitor Cannons
canhao_monitor.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Monitor Cannons"**
2. Tap on the desired cannon
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Choose type: **Visual** or **Functional**
6. Complete the checklist
7. If there is non-conformity, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**

chuveiro_lavaolhos.title: Guide - Eyewash Stations
chuveiro_lavaolhos.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Eyewash Stations"**
2. Tap on the desired equipment
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist
6. If there is non-conformity, attach photo (required)
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
chuveiro_lavaolhos.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly inspection required according to NR 20.

alarme.title: Guide - Alarm Systems
alarme.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Alarm Systems"**
2. Tap on the desired system
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist
6. If there is non-conformity, attach photo
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**

multigas.title: Guide - Multigas Detectors
multigas.howToRegisterTestContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Multigas Detectors"**
2. Tap on the desired detector
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date and time of the test
5. Choose type: **Periodic** or **Extraordinary**
6. Fill in cylinder reference values (LEL, O², H²S, CO)
7. Fill in values found in the test
8. Mark if you want to update values permanently
9. Add observations (optional)
10. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
multigas.faqFrequencyAnswer: Daily/weekly bump test before use in critical environments.

scba.title: Guide - Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)
scba.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)"**
2. Tap on the desired SCBA
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist (includes functional tests)
6. Add observations if necessary
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
scba.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly visual inspection required and before each use.

abrigo.title: Guide - Emergency Shelters
abrigo.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Emergency Shelters"**
2. Tap on the desired shelter
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Mark status: **Approved** or **Rejected**
6. Add observations (optional)
7. If rejected, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
abrigo.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly inspection required according to NBR 13714.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Guide
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of the status of all equipment
dashboard.whatYouSee: What do you see on the Dashboard?
dashboard.whatYouSeeContent:
**Metrics (top cards):**
- 📊 **Total:** Total number of registered equipment
- ✅ **OK:** Equipment in compliance
- ⚠️ **Pending:** Equipment without registered inspection

**Alert List:**
- Equipment with problems or pending items
- Equipment with expired or rejected inspections
dashboard.howToUseContent:
**To see equipment details:**
1. Go to **"Inspections"** in the bottom menu
2. Select the equipment type
3. Tap on the desired equipment

**To register new equipment:**
1. Go to **"Inspections"**
2. Select the equipment type
3. Tap the **"+"** button in the bottom right corner

**To see history:**
- Tap **"History"** in the bottom menu
dashboard.faqAccessEquipment: How do I access a specific equipment?
dashboard.faqAccessEquipmentAnswer: Go to "Inspections" → Select the type → Tap on the desired equipment.
dashboard.faqAlertsAnswer: Check the indicated equipment and register a new inspection or corrective action.

qr.tipScan: Keep the QR Code within the reading area and wait for automatic detection.

scbaChecklist.pressureTest: 1. Lock the demand valve (bypass). 2. Open and close the cylinder valve completely. 3. Monitor the gauges for 1 minute. 4. Criterion: Pressure drop must be less than 10 bar.
scbaChecklist.lowPressureAlarm: 1. With the system still pressurized, slowly release air through the purge button. 2. Observe the gauge. 3. Criterion: The audible alarm must trigger between 50-55 bar.
scbaChecklist.maskSeal: 1. Put on the mask and adjust the straps. 2. Cover the demand valve inlet with your hand. 3. Inhale gently. 4. Criterion: The mask must be sucked against the face and remain so, without leaks.
